headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 3-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald was also transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. James Outman is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, while Riley Greene is on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas in a trade involving the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals also made a trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 3-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Keider Montero earning the win. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise to 13-1 Victory Over Marlins**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge at the plate, hitting two home runs and driving in six runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. He was previously on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
